title: JTCD attenuates HF by inhibiting activation of HSCs through PPARalpha-TFEB axis-mediated lipophagy.
authors: Shao, Chang; Lan, Wenfang; Ding, Ying; Ye, Linmao; Huang, Jiaxin; Liang, Xiaofan; He, Yi; Zhang, Junjie
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方JTCD通过PPARalpha-TFEB轴调控脂自噬抑制肝星状细胞活化以治疗肝纤维化，虽含分子对接但核心为细胞与动物实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatic fibrosis (HF) is an intermediate stage in the progression of chronic liver disease to cirrhosis and has been shown to be a reversible pathological process. Known evidence suggests that activation of hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) and degradation of their lipid droplets (LDs) play an indispensable role in the process of HF. Jiawei Taohe Chengqi Decoction (JTCD) can inhibit the activation of HSCs in the process of HF, but the exact mechanism remains to be elucidated. PURPOSE: The aim of this study is to determine whether JTCD inhibits lipophagy and to explore the possible mechanisms of its HF effect in HSCs by regulating the PPARalpha/TFEB axis. METHODS: Network pharmacology and molecular docking were firstly applied to predict the potential mechanism of JTCD for the treatment of HF. In vivo, a mouse model of HF was constructed using carbon tetrachloride (CCl(4)) solution, and the efficacy of JTCD was assessed by staining of pathological sections, oil red O staining, immunofluorescence (IF), immunohistochemistry (IHC) staining, Western blotting and qRT-PCR. The intervention of JTCD was verified in vitro by induction of activated LX-2 cells with TGF-beta solution and intervention using agonists and antagonists of PPARalpha. Finally, transient transfection of cells using TFEB siRNA was performed for validation studies. RESULTS: JTCD effectively alleviated CCl(4)-induced HF in mice and reduced the levels of HF markers alpha-smooth muscle actin (alpha-SMA) and collagen I (COL1A1), and inhibited PPARalpha expression and lipophagy process. In vitro, JTCD delayed the degradation of LDs and reduced lipophagy in LX-2 cells, suggesting a mechanism involving PPARalpha/TFEB axis signaling regulation.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝纤维化（HF）是慢性肝病进展为肝硬化的中间阶段，并已被证明是一个可逆的病理过程。已知证据表明，肝星状细胞（HSCs）的激活及其脂滴（LDs）的降解在HF过程中发挥着不可或缺的作用。加味桃核承气汤（JTCD）可抑制HF过程中HSCs的激活，但其确切机制仍有待阐明。目的：本研究旨在确定JTCD是否抑制脂自噬，并探讨其通过调控PPARalpha/TFEB轴在HSCs中发挥HF效应的可能机制。方法：首先采用网络药理学和分子对接预测JTCD治疗HF的潜在机制。在体内，使用四氯化碳（CCl(4)）溶液构建小鼠HF模型，并通过病理切片染色、油红O染色、免疫荧光（IF）、免疫组织化学（IHC）染色、Western blotting和qRT-PCR评估JTCD的疗效。在体外，通过TGF-beta溶液诱导激活的LX-2细胞，并使用PPARalpha激动剂和拮抗剂进行干预，验证JTCD的作用。最后，使用TFEB siRNA进行细胞瞬时转染以进行验证研究。结果：JTCD有效减轻了CCl(4)诱导的小鼠HF，并降低了HF标志物α-平滑肌肌动蛋白（alpha-SMA）和I型胶原蛋白（COL1A1）的水平，同时抑制了PPARalpha表达和脂自噬过程。在体外，JTCD延缓了LX-2细胞中LDs的降解并减少了脂自噬，提示其机制涉及PPARalpha/TFEB轴信号调控。
